messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI started failing intermittently on quantized bring-ups. Metrics (BLEU/EM) oscillate between runs, sometimes a 4-8% drop, sometimes fine. I think this is a dataset/split leakage or RNG problem in the eval harness. Anyone else seeing this?
ashok: seeing the same on my branch. flaky evals, usually when we run 8 shards in parallel. sometimes val/test swap performance.
kevin: can you paste the failing job link / logs? might be the runner seeding.
maria: job: https://ci.internal/runs/81524  — logs attached. quick grep shows generator doing: `random.seed(int(time.time()))` inside synthetic_prompt_generator.py — sigh.
eva: oof. that's the culprit for nondeterminism for sure. but parallelization + reordering of fixtures can also change assignment to splits. two orthogonal issues.
kevin: agree. fix proposals: 1) remove time-based seeds and pin seeds or accept a seed param; 2) deterministic split assignment by hashing example ids so parallel shuffle/order doesn't change split.
maria: +1. also want run metadata to include dataset_version & fixture-commit so dashboards can show which dataset produced the run.
kevin: sample deterministic split snippet i tested locally:```python
import xxhash

def assign_split(example_id):
    h = xxhash.xxh64(example_id.encode()).intdigest()
    r = h % 100
    if r < 80:
        return 'train'
    if r < 90:
        return 'val'
    return 'test'
```This yields stable splits regardless of shuffle/order.
ashok: perfect. also pin RNG at top of generation pipeline:```python
import random, numpy as np
random.seed(SEED)
np.random.seed(SEED)
```we should pass SEED from CI env or dataset manifest.
eva: CI wiring: add a check that `dataset_manifest.json` contains `version` and `split_hash` fields, and fail the job if the split_hash changes when fixtures haven't been updated. simple script: `eval/ci/check_dataset_version.py`. add it as a pre-eval step.
sam: I'll update the dashboard to display dataset_version, split_hash, and fixture-commit on each run. we can also surface a badge for 'fixture deterministic' true/false.
ci-bot: Job 81524 — flaky-eval — finished: failed (non-zero exit). See logs: eval/runner.py: AssertionError: test metrics drift > threshold.
maria: action plan: (1) PR to synthetic generator to accept SEED param & remove time-based seeding (2) PR to eval-harness to add deterministic split function + unit tests (3) add dataset manifest with version + split_hash and CI check (4) dashboard patch to show dataset metadata. I'll open the generator PR now.
kevin: one more note on metric defs — some of our tests use macro-average F1 vs micro — that explains some >1% diffs when counts shift across classes due to split changes. let's standardize to micro-avg for token-level scoring in the harness. I'll open a separate PR to change the metric impl and add conversion tests.
eva: also add an integration test that runs the harness with `--seed=42` and verifies output hash against a golden fixture. cheap and catches nondeterminism.
maria: OK folks — splitting tasks: @kevin metric impl + tests, @ashok deterministic split tests, @eva CI check script & integration test, @sam dashboard. I'll link PRs here as they appear. thanks. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: New run queued: 81525 — running with SEED=42 and DATASET_VERSION=2026-03-19-rc1
maria: nice, if 81525 is stable we'll roll the fix to main.
kevin: FYI, I also found a tiny bug where eval-runner shuffles examples per shard using the same RNG instance across threads; fixed by creating independent deterministic RNG per shard (seed + shard_id). commit incoming.
sam: dashboard note: will show a tooltip with `dataset_version`, `split_hash`, `fixture_commit`, and `seed` for each eval run. should help debugging regressions.
maria: great. we'll aim to have CI guard and dashboard in by EOD. if anyone wants to pair on the integration test, ping me.
